deployments_detail.use: Alice AI assistant on YandexGPT/Alice foundation models; monetized in chats
deployments_detail.value: >2bn RUB revenue from Alice AI chat monetization in 2025 (self-claimed)

deployments_detail.use: Alice (Alisa) AI voice assistant — Russia's leading virtual assistant, running on the YandexGPT LLM to answer questions, control smart-home/services, and draft text across Android/iOS/Windows and smart speakers. Relaunched Oct 2025 as 'Alice AI'. [Yandex (YandexGPT)]

Neural-network ranking in Yandex Search — deep learning models (Palekh 2016, and later transformer architecture) used in production to interpret queries and rank web results across the dominant Russian search engine. [Yandex (MatrixNet / transformers)]
Neuro — generative AI answer engine inside Yandex Search that combines the search index with YandexGPT to produce concise summarized answers with sources. [Yandex (YandexGPT)]

Robotaxi / self-driving cars — Level 4 autonomous ride-hailing service (launched Innopolis 2018), with perception/planning neural stacks. Operated a fleet across Russia, Israel and the US before the 2022 spin-off/pause. [Yandex Self-Driving Group (later Avride)]
deployments_detail.value: ~14 million km autonomous driving; 5,000+ rides in Innopolis by 2020; ~170-vehicle fleet

deployments_detail.use: Yandex Translate — hybrid neural machine translation (NMT) + statistical machine translation service in production for consumer and enterprise translation (e.g., PressReader translating 7,000+ publications). [Yandex (NMT)]

Yandex Music recommender system — deep neural models analyzing 1,000+ signals to power music recommendations in production; underlying interaction data released as the Yambda-5B open dataset. [Yandex (deep neural recommender / ARGUS)]
deployments_detail.value: 4.79 billion user-item interactions in released dataset; 1,000+ factors analyzed

deployments_detail.use: YandexART — diffusion-based text-to-image / animation generation neural network, deployed in the Shedevrum app and Yandex AI Studio for image generation from text prompts. [Yandex (YandexART diffusion model)]

YandexGPT LLM family offered as a managed B2B API via Yandex Cloud / AI Studio (YandexGPT 5.1 Pro released Aug 2025) for RAG, summarization and text generation for business customers. [Yandex Cloud / Yandex B2B Tech (YandexGPT)]

Meteum / Neurometeum — AI weather forecasting using neural networks over radar, satellite and observation data for hyperlocal precipitation nowcasting (16-hour precipitation forecasts), in production in Yandex Weather. [Yandex (Meteum / Neurometeum)]
deployments_detail.value: 16-hour precipitation forecast horizon; 32M monthly Yandex Weather visitors

deployments_detail.use: Alice AI booking of restaurants/salon appointments via chat; image gen/edit model (ART 2.0); AI smart-camera event analysis

Yandex.Rover autonomous sidewalk delivery robots — using the same self-driving perception stack (3D object detection, occupancy grids) for last-mile delivery from post offices and restaurants (Grubhub partnership on US campuses). [Yandex Self-Driving Group]
deployments_detail.value: 36 robots delivering from 27 Moscow post offices (Oct 2021)

deployments_detail.use: SourceCraft Code Assistant — LLM-based AI coding assistant providing code completion/generation, integrated into popular editors and supporting 30+ programming languages. [Yandex (SourceCraft / YandexGPT)]
